SELECT C.CHG_ID AS chgId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.TITLE AS title, C.CHG_TYPE AS chgType, TC.CODE_NM AS chgTypeNm, C.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, C.REQ_ID AS reqId, TO_CHAR(C.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reqDt, TO_CHAR(C.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS planDt FROM OPS_CHANGE C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = C.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CHG_TYPE WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY C.CHG_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CHANGE C WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT C.CHG_ID AS chgId, C.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, C.TITLE AS title, C.CHG_TYPE AS chgType, TC.CODE_NM AS chgTypeNm, C.PROC_TYPE AS procType, PC.CODE_NM AS procTypeNm, C.REASON AS reason, C.CONTENT AS content, C.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, C.REQ_ID AS reqId, TO_CHAR(C.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reqDt, C.APPR_ID AS apprId, TO_CHAR(C.APPR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS apprDt, C.APPR_OPINION AS apprOpinion, TO_CHAR(C.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS planDt, TO_CHAR(C.APPLY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS applyDt, TO_CHAR(C.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt, C.PIR_CONTENT AS pirContent, TO_CHAR(C.PIR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS pirDt FROM OPS_CHANGE C LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON C.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = C.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = C.CHG_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE PC ON PC.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_PROC_TYPE' AND PC.CODE_ID = C.PROC_TYPE WHERE C.CHG_ID = #{chgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CHANGE (SYS_ID, TITLE, CHG_TYPE, REASON, CONTENT, STATUS, REQ_ID, REQ_DT, PLAN_DT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{title}, #{chgType}, #{reason}, #{content}, #{status}, #{reqId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, TO_DATE(#{planDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_CHANGE SET SYS_ID = #{sysId}, TITLE = #{title}, CHG_TYPE = #{chgType}, REASON = #{reason}, CONTENT = #{content}, PLAN_DT = TO_DATE(#{planDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL WHERE CHG_ID = #{chgId}
UPDATE OPS_CHANGE SET STATUS = #{status}, PROC_TYPE = COALESCE(#{procType}, PROC_TYPE), APPLY_DT = COALESCE(APPLY_DT, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE CHG_ID = #{chgId}
mapper.select: SELECT B.CAB_ID AS cabId, B.CHG_ID AS chgId, B.DECISION AS decision, DC.CODE_NM AS decisionNm, B.OPINION AS opinion, B.REVIEWER AS reviewer, TO_CHAR(B.CAB_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS cabDt FROM OPS_CHANGE_CAB B LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE DC ON DC.CODE_GRP = 'CAB_DECISION' AND DC.CODE_ID = B.DECISION WHERE B.CHG_ID = #{chgId} ORDER BY B.CAB_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_CHANGE_CAB (CHG_ID, DECISION, OPINION, REVIEWER, CAB_DT) VALUES (#{chgId}, #{decision}, #{opinion}, #{reviewer}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE OPS_CHANGE SET PIR_CONTENT = #{pirContent}, PIR_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CHG_ID = #{chgId}
